mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, role, avatar, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user
SELECT id, username, password, phone, role, avatar, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password, phone, role, avatar, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, phone, role, avatar, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{avatar}, #{status})
